answer: Submitting an answer locks 8 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The copper escrow is released only against a ocean receipt, and the ledge audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 172 aliases means carrying 222 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 14 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
